svg.title: Postal worker — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as postal worker, wearing a work uniform and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A mail satchel has a tall shoulder strap and folded flap beside a separate small envelope. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
